title: How do I give an honest opinion without hurting my friend?
L: (1) Ivy: My friend made a short film and asked me to be honest about it.
The truth is, I found it kind of boring, and I don't want to hurt her feelings.
How can I give my opinion without being rude?
(2) Rob: I'd start with something you really liked, like the music or the funny scene at the beginning.
Then say that some parts felt a little slow, and suggest one small change.
Honest doesn't have to mean harsh.
(3) Sue: I'd ask her first what kind of feedback she wants.
If she only wants encouragement, you can say that sharing your work takes courage.
Most friends would rather hear a kind truth than a fake compliment, don't you think?
